## User need

What task is difficult today, and who benefits from the change?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the outcome, alternatives considered, and any offline, privacy, accessibility, localization or compatibility constraints.

## Scope

Which editions or components would change? Identify optional network services or permissions. Use synthetic examples and omit private investigation data.
